about_the_game:
Waddle & Rescue is a sliding puzzle logic 3D game, where you'll take control of Teo the Penguin, a cute but brave adventurer, in his mission to rescue all the lost penguins around the world. Waddle your way across different biomes, sliding and solving puzzles in order to find his lost pals.

TEO’S ADVENTURE

Join Teo's adventure, where with your help he'll search for lost penguins all over the world. Prove you're a born adventurer and find them as quickly as possible!

FIND YOUR PALS

Every penguin counts! In this adventure, your friends are very important. The more help Teo enlists, the further he can explore the world in search of more lost friends!

Find each of the lost penguins in each biome. If you gather several of them, you can advance to different areas throughout the game. The more penguins you collect, the further you can go!

UNLOCK NEW LEVELS

Want more challenging levels? Then challenge yourself by completing them as quickly and efficiently as possible. This way, you'll not only unlock new levels, but you would also prove that Teo the Penguin is a born adventurer!

Replay levels and challenge yourself by completing them 100%. You'll unlock new areas, new biomes, and even obtain collectibles you may have missed ;)

KEY FEATURES

  • Handcrafted Levels

    +60 levels for you to complete! :D

  • Character Customization 

    Waddle & Slide with unique skins and customizable options for Teo! You can unlock these skins obtaining collectables throughout the game! :0

  • Gamepad Compatibility

    You can connect all types of gamepad for this game. But we recommend an xbox controller ;)

A MESSAGE FROM THE TEAM IGLOO

Thank you so much to everyone who took the time to read the description of our upcoming project:  "Waddle & Rescue".

We couldn't be happier to finally announce the game on Steam, and we'd like to thank everyone who's supporting us in bringing this game to life.

We're committed to working hard to make sure you have a fun yet challenging experience. We hope to count on your support as we reveal more details about the game in the future <3.
